__comment: RAGAS governance gate (FR-G9). Surfaces the published quality CONTRACT the RaaS governs itself by: the fleet verdict, per-KB PASS/FAIL, and per-KB sovereign RAGAS metric aggregates. Fed by scripts/ragas_gate.py --prometheus (node-exporter textfile → Prometheus job 'ragas-textfile'). Colours follow the Acme Brand book §20 data-viz palette (Saffron→Emerald→Navy→Teal→Gold). Emerald = pass, Saffron = fail/attention; Teal reserved for AI/predicted series only. Metrics appear only after the gate has run at least once (see docs/qa/OBSERVABILITY.md).
title: RAGAS Governance — Quality Contract

panels.title: Fleet verdict (RAGAS contract)
panels.description: 1 = every knowledge base clears every quality floor over a sufficient sample with zero grounded-but-uncited answers; 0 = at least one KB failed or the fleet is inconclusive. The single number the quality claim rests on.

panels.title: KBs passing the contract
panels.description: Count of knowledge bases currently clearing every floor (rag_ragas_gate_pass == 1). Compare against the per-KB table to the right to see which KBs are red.

panels.title: Questions scored (fleet)
panels.description: Total RAGAS-scored questions across all KBs in the last gate run (sum of rag_ragas_sample). Governance certifies a KB only above the min-sample floor — a low number here means the golden sets are too small to certify, not that quality is bad.

panels.title: Per-KB verdict (RAGAS gate)
panels.description: Each knowledge base's latest verdict against the contract. Value 1 = PASS, 0 = FAIL/INCONCLUSIVE; the 'status' label carries the exact verdict (pass / fail / inconclusive). Sourced from rag_ragas_gate_pass.

panels.title: Per-KB RAGAS metrics (latest run)
panels.description: Each KB's sovereign RAGAS aggregate per metric (faithfulness / answer_relevancy / context_precision / context_recall), judged on the platform's own in-boundary models. Contract floors: faithfulness ≥ 0.80, the rest ≥ 0.70. Sourced from rag_ragas_metric.

panels.title: Faithfulness over time (per KB)
panels.description: The grounded-or-abstain core metric — how supported each KB's answers are by their cited evidence — tracked across gate runs. The 0.80 floor is the contract's highest bar; a series dipping below it is a governance breach. Sourced from rag_ragas_metric{metric="faithfulness"}.
